name: RP Optical Lab Ltd
summary: RP Optical Lab Ltd. engages in the development, production, and marketing of optical and electro-optical products for military defence and homeland security markets in Israel. The company offers short, medium, and long wavelengths lenses; multispectral lenses; thermal cameras and sensors; multi-spectral products; multi-sensor systems; and other products. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Petah Tikva, Israel.
